violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device:patty melt(burger sandwich)=101F, 130F, 99F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION. Discarded

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: spicy chicken=61, 44, chicken-less=44F, at Cold-sandwich line serving table.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. REPLACED DURING TYE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: Top of ovens and lighter coking equipment located under the exhausted hood system, were observed to be dusty.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The DELFIELD HEATED Cabinet, at the serving area, is not operating properly and not able to maintain foods at 135F or higher.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. Do not use this unit until at has been rep[aired and able to maintain foods at the proper temperatures of 135 and above, to prevent the growth of harmful bacterial. If it can no. longer be fixed, replace it. FAIRFAX HIGH SCHOOL (Inspection Date: 10/29/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: The two side-by side hand washing sinks that are located on one of the serving lines, do not have adequate hot water. The naming hilt water temperature at these sinks was 845F.
violations.corrective_action: Provide or adjust the hot water temperature, to meet at least the minimum requirement of 100F. All hand washing sink hot water must be 100F and above.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the floor drains under the 3-vat and 2-vat sinks are in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: Some squeeze bottles containing sauces were not properly labeled to identify contents.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CDI -All were labeled properly during the Inspection.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: EHS OBSERVED BAGS OF SHREDDED MOZZARELLA CHEESE THAWING ON PREP TABLE AT ROOM TEMPERATURE.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. BAGS OF SHREDDED MOZZARELLA WERE RELOCATED TO PREP SINK UNDER COLD RUNNING WATER.
